_about: Screens the dev tool's preview can load. Read on every request (no restart). fixture = an entry of fixtures (a save seeded into slot 1 of the preview's own storage, never your real saves); hold = stay on the loading screen; freeze (default true) = stop game time once the steps are done. steps run in the preview after boot: {waitFor: selector, timeout?}, {click: selector}, {key: 'KeyT'} (a game hotkey, by e.code), {show: selector} / {hide: selector} (remove / add the hidden class), {wait: ms}, {include: 'presetId'}, {eval: 'js'} (W = window.__wands, G = the game state, UI), {freeze: true|false}. The order here is the dropdown order.
